run_note: Run covering 2026-08-04 -> 2026-08-08, executed 08:50 ET Saturday. Four days elapsed since the previous run, so this pass audited the full window: 33 new fills (14 equity, 19 crypto), 19 attribution lines, 2 judgments made, 1 closed. Two things lead this run. FIRST, a SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT on hype trader's 08-06 SOUN buy - the first confirmed bad fill since the 07-22 incident, and a different fault from that one: the market-hours gate worked (fill was 09:42 ET on a Thursday), the PRICE was stale. SECOND, my own 2026-08-04-hunter-1 judgment closed at -115.62, my largest loss, and it failed on its stated mechanism rather than on luck - see per_bot.hunter. Fleet baseline is $9,000 across 9 active bots, NOT the $8,000 in the original task spec: stock/TQQQ retired 07-31, scholar and analyst added.
win_rate_note: 108 of 128 closed judgments are no_change (alpha 0), so the headline rate is near-meaningless - read the directional record. DIRECTIONAL: 20 scored, 11W/6L/3N, +204.48 net headline. On the conservative actionable-reference-price basis: +80.39. THIS RUN: one closure, 2026-08-04-hunter-1, a -115.62 loss - larger in absolute terms than my best win (+131.16) and enough to cut cumulative actionable alpha by 59%. Eleven wins against six losses still reads positive, but the loss distribution is now clearly fatter on the downside and every one of the six losses is the same trade shape: betting against a momentum bot's next entry.

this_run_closures.summary: Bot left UPRO at 148.65 leaving 864.84, then rotated PLTR (148.37 -> 163.955) and into SLV at 55.92, marking 980.46 on Friday: +115.62 taken vs 0.00 sitting in cash. per_bot.hunter: Thesis retired this run after seven instances (4 paid, 3 cost). The re-entry-discipline claim rested on entries clustering near the day's high on the first cycle after a blackout; the 08-04 and 08-05 entries were both near the day's low and both worked. Root confound: the market-hours gate forces every equity fill into the first cycle after 09:30 ET, so post-blackout and post-open are the same fills on most days. I was reading a scheduler artefact as strategy behaviour. No further calls on this bot's entry timing.
per_bot.sentiment: First directional call against this bot since 07-30. It has now made four hype rotations in the window; three were genuine and two of those were good (CRWV->PLTR caught earnings for +10.4% in a session). The NET entry is the outlier on quality: bought at the 88th percentile of the day's range into an already-reported 15% surge, -5.85% by the close. SEPARATELY AND MORE IMPORTANTLY: this book's headline 1216.04 includes roughly 185 of profit from the corrupt SOUN fill and should be read as about 1031.
per_bot.crypto: Churn thesis resumed after a week suspended, on new evidence rather than a new opinion. The owner shipped a cost model between runs; costs_paid is now an explicit field and reads 23.10 on this book. The 08-05 LINK cycles are the clean demonstration: eleven legs moved the book 1078.77 -> 1077.80 while paying 14.70 in fees. That is a strategy paying to stand still, and it is now measurable instead of hypothetical.
per_bot.analyst: Reasoning validated true and falsifier did not fire, for the second consecutive review. api_cost_usd 0.2771 across 5 decisions = about 0.055 each, inside the expected 0.05-0.30 band, no runaway. One defect worth the owner's eye: the 08-05 decision was an agent_error that defaulted to HOLD at zero tokens. The guardrail did exactly its job, but one malformed response in five is a 20% rate on a small sample.
